question: Which bodily parts become excellently pure through rubbing and smelling respectively?
premises: Rubbing is linked to the back of the hand
Smelling is linked to the tip of the nose
The resulting state is described as excellent
inference: Rubbing purifies the back of the hand and smelling purifies the tip of the nose excellently.
uncertainties: The verb of becoming is implied rather than explicitly stated
plain_english: From rubbing, the back of the hand becomes pure; from smelling, the tip of the nose becomes excellently pure.
